title: Give every model a cost record, cache rates included
goal: Give every candidate model a cost record: input, output, cache-hit and cache-miss rates, plus measured latency and throughput where known, with the source and date of each figure. Cache-hit pricing is the point - DeepSeek-class caching is what makes the cheapest model the best one, so a record without cache rates cannot rank anything. No new third-party dependency: this is data plus arithmetic.
